messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT created - anomaly detected for model variant `omega-lite-v2.3` (generation drift + hallucination uptick). Error rate 9.1% over last 10m (baseline ~0.5%). Routing weight currently 12% across prod. Starting triage.
ashley: ack. paging matt oncall. any customer-facing errors reported yet?
matt: oncall here. seeing increase in relevance failures in logs, a handful of retries. not memory OOM. latency ok. can someone attach the failing example ids?
devon: attaching sample outputs and eval diff (snip). most failures are short-answer hallucinations and contradicting facts. sample request/response:
```
req: "Summarize product compatibility"
resp: "Product works on Solaris 2.6"  <-- incorrect
```
samir: a couple of large keys (enterprise-42, partner-x) drive 40% of omega-lite traffic. suspect new quant path interacts poorly with long-context prompts.
lisa: customer support has 3 open tickets flagged as "nonsense output"; no security/PHI exposure. priority medium.
ashley: plan: 1) reduce traffic to omega-lite to 1% immediately 2) enable explicit fallback to `stable-v1` for requests failing sanity checks 3) apply soft per-key throttle for heavy keys 4) if unstable, fully deactivate variant. Matt / devon, can you run step 1 now?
matt: running weighted-route adjust.
deploy-bot: executing route-change job job-8142
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/redwood/routing/change -d '{"variant":"omega-lite-v2.3","set_weight":0.01}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ****'
```
ops-bot: route-change job-8142 started by @matt
matt: route-change completed. omega-lite weighting now 1% across prod regions. :white_check_mark:
devon: enabling fallback rule (sanity-check -> stable-v1) now. patch:
```
if output.score < 0.4 or contains_flag("hallucination") then use model stable-v1
```
ops-bot: fallback-rule applied in edge config (id fc-992)
ashley: applying soft ephemeral quotas for heavy keys: enterprise-42 -> 60% of previous throughput, partner-x -> 50% for 30m window. prod-support please notify affected customers proactively.
prod-support: message drafted and queued to enterprise-42 and partner-x. awaiting matt confirmation for quota API call.
matt: applying keywise adjustments.
```
# keywise throttle
POST /internal/quotas/update
{
  "keys": ["enterprise-42","partner-x"],
  "policies": {"enterprise-42":"0.6","partner-x":"0.5"},
  "duration":"30m"
}
```
ops-bot: quota-update acknowledged (q-778). throttles active.
ashley: monitoring dashboards for 10m, then decide on deactivate. any sign of customer error rate improving?
devon: after weight drop + fallback we see hallucination rate drop to 1.3% in 5m window. customer tickets rate plateauing. good trend.
samir: telemetry shows degraded quality still for long-context prompts; but volume from heavy keys down by 48%.
ashley: good. escalate to product/R&D: stayed open as a rollback candidate. @lisa please capture customer impact notes.
lisa: noted. ticket IDs: CS-1842, CS-1849, CS-1850. sent update to customers: "We've routed your traffic to a more stable variant and applied safeguards; investigating root cause."
matt: will keep this as P1 idling. prepping a full deactivate if trend reverses. also starting a canary rollback of omega-lite's quant kernel (v2.3 -> v2.2-quant) in staging.
deploy-bot: canary rollback job job-8149 started in staging
ops-bot: alert: additional spike in hallucination instances seen in EU region 3m ago; bumping attention. need to consider full deactivate for EU if not improving.
ashley: do we have capacity on stable-v1 to absorb extra traffic if we fully deactivate?\ndevon: yes, stable-v1 headroom ~28% across clusters. safe to shift.
matt: decision: hold for 15 more minutes with throttles and fallbacks. if hallucination rate >3% in 15m -> initiate full deactivate of omega-lite across all regions and rehome traffic to stable-v1. I'll post an action when I flip.
ashley: paging handoff at 45m for follow-up. matt, if you step down before then, handoff to devon.
matt: understood. I'll be primary until handoff.
(15m later)
matt: trending: global hallucination rate 0.9% - below threshold. large keys still stable. will extend throttles another 30m and keep fallback rule.
ashley: thanks. product wants postmortem and root-cause tracking. created incident ticket INC-24321 and assigned to devon for RCA.
devon: taking RCA. initial hypothesis: quantized kernel interaction with certain multi-turn tokenization patterns caused factual drift. will run targeted reproductions.
ashley: closing active mitigation. kept throttles and fallback for 60m additional monitoring window. if any regression, re-open thread and escalate page. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: INCIDENT updated - mitigations applied, monitoring extension set 60m (INC-24321)
matt: handing off to devon for RCA and follow-up on rollback test results. oncall handover at 2432110500 to devon. :wave:
devon: acknowledged handoff. will post RCA draft and regression test schedule in #eng-ml.
prod-support: customers notified and ticket statuses updated to "mitigations applied". no escalations so far.
ashley: thanks everyone. summary: rapid pullback to 1% weight, fallback to stable-v1, soft keywise throttles, monitoring. RCA owner: devon. Incident will remain open until postmortem complete.
ops-bot: INCIDENT closed for paging purposes but remains monitored (INC-24321).
